This is an expression of interest for future Account Executive opportunities, not a live vacancy. We review submissions as relevant openings become available.

About us

Chainstack powers global blockchain applications across fintech, DeFi, wallets, custodians, analytics, and everything in between. Teams cut time-to-market, cost, and risk with one platform for nodes in the cloud, offered through preferred service providers, or self-hosted. Standardized node management puts reliability on autopilot and keeps performance predictable, giving operators control and transparency while developers get a consistent way to build and scale.

About the role

Account Executive is responsible for generating new revenue in target accounts from sales across Chainstack's product suite.

Responsibilities

  • Gain a deep understanding of our technology, value proposition, and target markets, embracing our proven sales methodology for winning.
  • Use active listening and consultative sales skills to understand our prospects and position how Chainstack can uniquely solve their problems.
  • Effectively convey how Chainstack can solve each prospect’s specific problems.
  • Positively contribute to the Chainstack culture, working alongside colleagues to forge a strong team-based sales approach.

Requirements

  • You are hyper-competitive, high-energy, and driven to do what it takes to succeed. In all areas of your life, you like to contend and win, and don't back down from a challenge. You are used to succeeding in difficult environments and enjoy the thrill of the hunt.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment and seek more than just a routine 9-5 job.
  • You are an excellent writer and highly articulate. You love to present in front of others however you understand that listening is key to connecting with your audience.
  • You are passionate about technology and soak up new systems and concepts like a sponge. Learning quickly, you are not afraid to try things for yourself nor fail.
  • Your strong analytical skills will see you diagnose problems and engineer solutions.
  • Your ability to combine your unique talents with a desire to understand prospect needs and present a compelling vision of a future solution will make you successful in this role.
  • Proven track record of exceeding quota, preferably in a technical product/solution-sales environment

What we offer

  • Competitive salary in USD- Fair, transparent compensation based on experience and impact.
  • Stock options- Share in Chainstack's growth and long-term success.
  • AI-first environment - Use AI to reduce repetitive work and focus on judgment and shipping.
  • Cutting-edge tech stack- Work with modern infrastructure and stay close to Web3 innovation.
  • Flat structure, no bureaucracy- Take ownership, move fast, and make decisions with real impact.
  • Flexible schedule- Work when you are most productive and maintain balance.
  • Global, fast-growing market- Build in a rapidly evolving industry with real customer demand.
  • Diverse, multinational team- Collaborate with people across countries, backgrounds, and functions.

Ready to take your career to the next level? Submit your expression of interest.

raw.description:
About Keystone

Keystone is one of the largest and fastest-growing insurance brokerages in the country — ranked #26 among U.S. retail brokers and #4 fastest-growing in the Top 50 by Business Insurance. Our platform spans 33+ states, 180+ agency partners, and more than $500 million in revenue — uniting some of the country's most respected independent agencies with the scale, tools, and resources of a national brokerage. Through operational support in finance, HR, marketing, technology, producer development, and M&A, we empower agencies to grow while preserving what makes them who they are — their client relationships and their role in the communities they serve. Guided by our trademarked commitment, "Trust, our most important policy," Keystone is building the insurance solution every family and business can count on. For more information, visit .

Commercial Lines Producer

Position Summary:

The primary function of this role is to drive new business growth and maintain a profitable book of commercial insurance accounts. This role is responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building long-term client relationships, and delivering customized insurance and risk management solutions. The ideal candidate is a consultative sales professional with a passion for helping businesses protect their assets and achieve their goals through strategic insurance planning.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Sales

  • Prospect and cultivate new commercial insurance opportunities through networking, referrals, cold outreach, community involvement, and industry events.
  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans in partnership with Sales Leadership to achieve individual and agency growth objectives.
  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments to understand client exposures and recommend tailored insurance solutions.
  • Prepare and present professional insurance proposals that clearly communicate coverage options, value, and competitive advantages.
  • Maintain an active and organized sales pipeline within the CRM, ensuring timely follow-up and accurate forecasting.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team on targeted prospecting campaigns and lead generation initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell additional insurance products and coordinate referrals across business lines.

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for commercial clients throughout the sales process and beyond.
  • Develop long-term relationships by delivering exceptional service, proactive communication, and ongoing risk management guidance.
  • Conduct regular policy reviews to ensure coverage remains aligned with clients' evolving business needs while identifying opportunities for additional products and services.
  • Partner closely with Account Managers to ensure a seamless client experience, promote retention, and support account growth.

Market and Industry Knowledge

  • Stay informed on commercial insurance products, carrier appetites, underwriting guidelines, market trends, and regulatory developments.
  • Build and maintain productive relationships with insurance carriers and underwriters to negotiate competitive coverage and pricing.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities, industry conferences, networking events, and continuing education programs.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely documentation of sales activities, client interactions, and account information within the agency management system (Applied Epic) and CRM.
  • Ensure all new business submissions, renewals, endorsements, and policy documentation comply with agency standards, carrier requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Coordinate with internal service teams to ensure a smooth transition from new business to ongoing account management.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, or a related field preferred
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in business development, consultative sales, or a client-facing role
  • Demonstrated success in prospecting, relationship building, and consultative selling
  • Proven ability to meet or exceed sales goals in a competitive environment
  • Ability to obtain a Property & Casualty Insurance License upon hire; obtaining a Life & Health Insurance license is encouraged
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
  • Familiarity with Applied Epic, or comparable agency management system, and CRM systems preferred
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to establish credibility and build lasting client relationships
  • Highly organized with excellent time management and follow-through
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments
  • Willingness to travel for client meetings, networking events, and professional development opportunities
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check, as permitted by law

Work Environment: This position offers hybrid or remote work options, depending on the candidate's location and business needs.

Salary Transparency Statement: In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws, we will provide the applicable salary range upon request to candidates who reside in jurisdictions where such disclosure is required.

Benefits:

  • Competitive Compensation Package
  • Health Insurance Plans (PPO, HSA, Copay Options)
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Company Paid Disability Insurance
  • Supplemental Insurance including Critical Illness, Accident, Legal, Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with Safe Harbor Match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays

No Solicitation Notification to Agencies: Please note that Keystone and our Partner Agencies do not accept unsolicited resumes or calls from third-party recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Master Service Agreement and approval from HR to submit resumes for a specific requisition, Keystone will not consider or approve payment to any third parties for hires made.

Remote Client Benefits Representative | Work From Home

Company: AO Globe Life
Location: 100% Remote – United States
Job Type: Full-Time | Flexible Schedule | Training & Mentorship Provided
Experience: Entry-Level Candidates Welcome

Build a Meaningful Career While Helping Working Families

Are you looking for a work-from-home career where you can help people, build lasting relationships, develop professionally, and create long-term earning potential?

AO Globe Life is seeking motivated, service-oriented professionals to join our growing virtual team as Remote Client Benefits Representatives.

You'll meet with individuals and families through scheduled Zoom and phone appointments, answer questions about available benefits, identify coverage needs, assist with enrollment, and provide ongoing client service.

This position combines customer service, relationship management, benefits education, and consultative insurance sales in a fully remote environment.

Whether you're an experienced professional or exploring a new career path, we provide comprehensive training, licensing guidance, mentorship, and ongoing development.

No previous insurance experience is required.

Opportunity Highlights

✓ 100% Remote – Work From Home
✓ Qualified Client Opportunities Provided
✓ No Lead Purchasing Required
✓ Weekly Performance-Based Pay
✓ Performance Bonuses & Renewal Income Opportunities
✓ Flexible Scheduling
✓ Comprehensive Training & Licensing Guidance
✓ Leadership Development & Career Advancement

What You'll Do

As a Remote Insurance & Client Benefits Representative, you'll work directly with clients throughout the benefits and enrollment process.

Client Service & Benefits Support

  • Conduct scheduled client appointments through Zoom and phone
  • Connect with individuals and families seeking benefit information
  • Learn about each client's needs and financial protection goals
  • Explain available life, accident, and supplemental health insurance benefits
  • Answer questions about coverage options and policy features
  • Provide personalized, needs-based recommendations
  • Guide clients through applications and enrollment
  • Assist with required documentation

Ongoing Client Relationships

  • Build long-term relationships through exceptional service and consistent communication
  • Conduct policy reviews when appropriate
  • Assist with beneficiary updates and policy service requests
  • Provide ongoing support after enrollment
  • Maintain organized and accurate client records
  • Follow applicable company procedures and regulatory requirements

Professional Development

  • Participate in structured virtual onboarding
  • Attend weekly coaching and training sessions
  • Receive mentorship from experienced leaders
  • Develop communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills
  • Build insurance product and industry knowledge
  • Participate in leadership development opportunities

100% Remote Work

Work from home while remaining connected to a collaborative virtual organization.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work remotely within the United States
  • Eliminate the daily commute
  • Conduct client appointments virtually
  • Use modern digital business and communication tools
  • Receive remote coaching, training, and team support
  • Build greater flexibility into your professional life

Qualified Client Opportunities

Representatives have access to company-provided client opportunities, including individuals who have expressed interest in receiving information about available benefits.

This allows you to focus your time on:

  • Scheduled client consultations
  • Benefits education
  • Customer service
  • Needs-based recommendations
  • Enrollment assistance
  • Relationship building
  • Long-term client support

No purchasing leads is required.

Weekly Pay & Performance-Based Earning Potential

This is a commission-based insurance opportunity rather than an hourly or salaried customer service position.

Compensation opportunities may include:

  • Weekly commission payments
  • Performance-based bonuses
  • Renewal and residual income opportunities
  • Leadership incentives
  • Performance recognition programs

Earning potential is not capped by a predetermined salary; however, income depends on individual activity, production, and results.

Individual earnings vary, and no specific income level is guaranteed.

Comprehensive Training & Licensing Guidance

No Insurance Experience Required

We welcome motivated candidates from a wide variety of professional backgrounds.

Training and development may include:

  • Virtual onboarding
  • Insurance product education
  • Client needs assessment
  • Customer service development
  • Consultative sales training
  • Virtual presentation skills
  • Enrollment procedures and systems
  • Relationship management
  • Weekly coaching
  • One-on-one mentorship
  • Leadership development

Candidates who are not currently licensed will receive guidance through the applicable state Life & Health Insurance licensing process.

Career Growth & Leadership Development

AO Globe Life provides opportunities for representatives who demonstrate strong performance, consistency, professionalism, and leadership potential to continue advancing.

Career development opportunities may include:

  • Training and mentorship
  • Team development
  • Leadership
  • Management
  • Professional development
  • Senior leadership pathways

Advancement is based on performance, initiative, results, and demonstrated leadership—not simply seniority.

Benefits & Professional Support

Qualifying representatives may have access to:

  • Health insurance reimbursement program
  • Company-supported life insurance
  • Renewal and residual income opportunities
  • OPEIU Local 277 representation, where applicable
  • Leadership development programs
  • Professional conferences and events
  • Virtual technology and business resources

Eligibility and qualification requirements apply to applicable programs.

Recognition & Incentives

Outstanding performance may qualify representatives for:

  • Company-sponsored incentive travel
  • Leadership conferences
  • Performance awards
  • Recognition programs
  • Professional development experiences
  • Additional advancement opportunities

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for individuals who demonstrate:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities
  • Positive and professional demeanor
  • Self-motivation and personal accountability
  • Dependability and strong follow-through
  • Effective organization and time management
  • Goal-oriented mindset
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfort communicating through Zoom and phone
  • Basic computer proficiency
  • Coachability and willingness to learn
  • Professionalism, reliability, and integrity

Experience That Transfers Well

Previous experience in any of the following areas is helpful but not required:

  • Customer Service
  • Client Success
  • Client Relations
  • Insurance
  • Sales
  • Banking
  • Financial Services
  • Healthcare
  • Retail
  • Hospitality
  • Education
  • Military
  • Administrative Support
  • Call Center Operations
  • Business Development
  • Account Management

We value communication, professionalism, integrity, coachability, and work ethic as much as previous industry experience.

Minimum Requirements

Applicants must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Be legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Be physically located within the United States
  • Have access to a computer or laptop
  • Maintain reliable high-speed internet
  • Have webcam and microphone capability
  • Maintain a quiet, professional workspace
  • Be comfortable conducting virtual client appointments
  • Be willing to complete required training
  • Hold or be willing and able to obtain the appropriate state Life & Health Insurance License

Licensing guidance is available for candidates who are not currently licensed.

Interview Process

Qualified candidates will complete a brief career overview covering the position, client responsibilities, compensation structure, licensing requirements, training, and advancement opportunities.

Candidates interested in continuing will then have the opportunity to schedule a live Zoom interview with our hiring team.

The entire interview process is conducted virtually for convenience and accessibility.

Ready to Build Your Future?

If you're looking for a remote insurance, customer service, and sales career where you can help families, enjoy flexibility, develop professionally, and build long-term opportunities through your performance, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today to be considered for our Remote Insurance & Client Benefits Representative opportunity with AO Globe Life.

Work From Home. Help Families. Build Relationships. Grow Your Future. 🚀

raw.title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist
raw.excerpt: Media buying has changed. In 2026, a great media buyer is not just a button pusher.
raw.description:
Media buying has changed.

In 2026, a great media buyer is not just a button pusher. They understand the full system: creative, offer, conversion rate, platform dynamics, competition, and what to test next.

At Sweat Pants Agency, we are hiring a performance media buyer who can drive growth across Meta ads for DTC and ecommerce brands.

This role is for someone who can run paid media and also think like a marketer.

You will build testing roadmaps, guide creative strategy, communicate with clients, and help us scale what works.

If you've built or scaled your own eCommerce brand, we want to hear from you.

If you love following SOPs and repeating the same campaign structure forever, this is not the job.

If you love thinking, testing, and building frameworks that win, keep reading.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Own paid media strategy for DTC/eCommerce clients across Meta and TikTok
  • Build creative testing roadmaps — develop angles, write briefs for editors, analyze what's working
  • Manage ad budgets ranging from $30k / mo to $1m / mo per client
  • Diagnose the full funnel — spot whether issues are creative, offer, or conversion
  • Communicate clearly with clients — present results, plans, and next steps
  • Work with UGC creators — source talent, write scripts, direct content when needed

You're A Great Fit If...

You have hands-on experience scaling eCommerce brands:

  • You've managed Meta Ads with real spend and can show results (CPA, ROAS, revenue)
  • Bonus: You've built/operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand

You understand creative is the lever:

  • You can pull insights from reviews, competitor ads, and comments to generate new angles
  • You've written UGC scripts or creative briefs
  • You can work with editors to create winning ad variations
  • Video editing or design skills are a plus

You're a strategist, not a robot:

  • You challenge assumptions and adapt fast
  • You don't blindly follow "best practices"
  • You can explain what you're doing and why

You have ownership and urgency:

  • You act like it's your money
  • You move fast and follow through
  • You don't wait to be told what to do

Benefits

Why This Role Is Exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Digital Solutions Practice

Michael Baker International's Digital Solutions practice designs, builds, and operates the cloud, data, and technology platforms that enable MBI's mission-critical engineering and consulting work. With expertise spanning multi-cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, application delivery, and AI/ML enablement, the Digital Solutions team drives the digital transformation of MBI's internal and client-facing capabilities in support of the company's Vision 2030 strategic roadmap. The practice supports a broad portfolio of engineering disciplines—transportation, infrastructure, water, environment, and federal services—by delivering scalable, secure, and resilient technology foundations that accelerate project delivery and operational excellence. Guided by principles of automation, infrastructure as code, and DevOps best practices, Digital Solutions maintains a modern technology environment that supports thousands of professionals across the enterprise and positions MBI as a technology-forward leader in the architecture, engineering, and construction industry.

What We're Looking For

Michael Baker International is seeking a Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer to join our Digital Solutions team in a fully remote capacity. In this hands-on senior role, you will design, build, and maintain MBI's enterprise cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services collaborating with the VP of Product, VP of Infrastructure, and CISO to align cloud platforms with product delivery, operational reliability, and security compliance. You will play a pivotal role in advancing MBI's Vision 2030 digital transformation strategy—driving CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code practices, AI/ML infrastructure enablement, and platform engineering across the enterprise.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement enterprise-scale multi-cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and AWS, with a focus on Azure as the primary platform, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and performance for all environments and services.
  • Develop and deploy Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform as the primary tool, with proficiency in ARM/Bicep and AWS CloudFormation to standardize cloud provisioning, enforce configuration governance, and enable repeatable, version-controlled deployments.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and GitHub as the primary version control system to automate build, test, and deployment processes aligned with product delivery timelines.
  • Establish comprehensive monitoring, observability, and incident response capabilities using Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Datadog, and Prometheus to uphold enterprise SLAs, detect anomalies, and drive continuous reliability improvement.
  • Manage Azure infrastructure fundamentals including subscriptions, tenants, VNets, VWAN, Network Security Groups, and firewalls to establish secure, scalable, and compliant cloud foundations.
  • Drive cloud cost optimization through FinOps practices—leveraging Azure Cost Management and AWS Cost Explorer to right-size resources, implement governance frameworks, and eliminate waste across the enterprise.
  • Enforce security and compliance standards across cloud environments in partnership with the CISO, implementing IAM controls, network segmentation, encryption, and zero-trust architecture aligned with SOC 2, FedRAMP, and CMMC requirements.
  • Serve as MBI's primary technical liaison with Microsoft Azure and AWS—managing vendor partnerships, coordinating architecture reviews, and aligning the cloud roadmap with provider capabilities and strategic initiatives.
  • Write automation scripts and tools in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to streamline infrastructure deployment, system integration, and DevOps workflows.

What You Need to Succeed

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and managing cloud infrastructure in production environments across both Microsoft Azure and AWS
  • Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code including Terraform, Azure Resource Manager/Bicep, and AWS CloudFormation, with demonstrated proficiency in modular design, state management, and environment promotion strategies
  • Proficiency in CI/CD pipeline development and maintenance using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or AWS CodePipeline
  • Strong scripting and coding abilities in Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automation, system integration, and DevOps workflow development
  • Proven experience with cloud security implementation including IAM, zero-trust architecture, network segmentation, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, FedRAMP)
  • Experience with cloud cost management, FinOps practices, and cloud governance frameworks at enterprise scale
  • Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools including Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders including CTO-level executives
  • Preferred: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS), Docker, and container orchestration in production environments
  • Preferred: Experience building and managing cloud infrastructure for AI/ML workloads including GPU compute, vector databases, and model serving pipelines
  • Preferred: Experience with platform engineering practices and internal developer platform (IDP) development
  • Preferred: Professional certifications in AWS (Solutions Architect Professional), Microsoft Azure (Solutions Architect Expert), or HashiCorp (Terraform Associate)

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience migrating infrastructure and workloads from AWS to Azure.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Ansible, or other infrastructure automation frameworks.
  • Expertise in Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and Docker container orchestration in production environments.
  • Experience building and managing cloud infrastructure for AI/ML workloads including GPU compute, vector databases, and model serving pipelines.
  • Professional certifications in AWS (Solutions Architect Professional), Microsoft Azure (Solutions Architect Expert), or HashiCorp (Terraform Associate).
  • Experience with cloud cost management, FinOps practices, and governance frameworks at enterprise scale.
  • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) background with exposure to SLI/SLO definition and incident response frameworks.
  • Experience with platform engineering practices and internal developer platform (IDP) development.

Compensation

The approximate compensation range for this position is $110,000 to $190,000. This compensation range is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation is dependent upon factors such as education, qualifications, experience, skillset, and physical work location.

Why Choose Us

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Life, AD&D, short-term, and long-term disability
  • Professional and personal development
  • Generous paid time off
  • Commuter and wellness benefits

Senior Travel Consultant, ERM (Remote)

Full time, Brazil

The Senior Travel Consultant, ERM is responsible for accurately and efficiently handling incoming requests via multiple channels (i.e. phone, email, etc.) and handling additional duties as assigned within a global, mutli- regional setup. You will be the primary point of contact for the customer and provide active travel consultation towards the business customers, including providing travel details and up-selling of related products.

This position demonstrates an extensive understanding and applicability of all areas in the travel industry. You wil work independently on requests as assigned and take the initiative to provide assistance.

The Senior Travel Consultant, ERM works with the team to provide day-to-day assistance. You will be the first point of contact for team members and respond to questions, providing direction on policies and procedures. You may work in project teams on projects related to operations and coach travel consultants when team lead is absent.

As a Senior Travel Consultant, ERM, you will

  • Expertly use the appropriate the BCD Travel tools and systems to complete requests
  • Anticipate and provide assistance on potential challenges that may arise for the customer
  • Respond to the customer promptly and provide the customer with your undivided attention to the request
  • Seek opportunities to review operational processes and the commercial relationship with customer and provides suggestions for improvement
  • Perform quality management such as error management and assist in projects as assigned
  • Meet individual and team goals

About you

  • Proven experience in ERM, marine, offshore, or crew travel environments
  • Hands‑on expertise managing crew movements, rotations, and disruption handling
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to perform accurately under pressure
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, 24/7 service environment
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within a global, multi‑regional operations setup
  • Solid working knowledge of the travel industry, policies, procedures and processes
  • Advanced skills on GDS Amadeus
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Proven ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Demonstrated excellent professional customer service and problem resolution skills

What we offer you

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

About us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

You’ll be offered

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities
  • Opportunities to grow your skillset and career
  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts
  • An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

Ready to join the journey? Apply now!

We’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about a role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply.

We are committed to providing reasonable and necessary accommodations to ensure all employees can perform their roles effectively. For accommodation requests or further information, contact our Talent Acquisition department at .

Über uns:
Wir gestalten die Zukunft des Wohnens – mit intelligenten Lösungen für mehr Energieeffizienz, Nachhaltigkeit und Transparenz. Unser Ziel ist es, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem unsere Ambassadors – so nennen wir unsere Customer Service Teammitglieder – mit Freude, Motivation und Sinn arbeiten können.

Bei uns zählt Teamgeist ebenso wie Eigenverantwortung: Wir bieten moderne, digital vernetzte Arbeitsstrukturen, die Flexibilität und Stabilität miteinander verbinden. So können unsere Ambassadors jeden Tag ihr Bestes geben – für sich, ihr Team und unsere Kunden.

raw.description:
Symetra has an exciting new opportunity to join us as Director of Product Management, Infrastructure and Operations!

About the role

In this role, you will lead a unified product strategy across the organization, aligning cross-team efforts and driving clear, actionable roadmaps. You’ll mentor and develop a high-performing product team while partnering closely with developers and engineers as your primary customers. Operating at the intersection of infrastructure and operations, you’ll use your technical fluency and leadership to influence partners, build strong cross-functional relationships, and create clarity and momentum in a complex environment.

What you will do

  • Lead strategy and execution across a portfolio of products, aligning with customer needs and business goals
  • Connect initiatives across teams into a cohesive strategy with clear priorities and roadmaps
  • Partner with cross-functional and executive leaders to shape product direction and deliver outcomes at scale
  • Establish and evolve product management best practices across teams
  • Manage, coach, and support product managers to drive strong, shared outcomes
  • Leverage customer insights and performance data to inform prioritization and continuous improvement
  • Bring domain expertise in infrastructure and operations to guide product decisions
  • Collaborate closely with developers and engineers, bridging business, platform, and technical needs
  • Build strong relationships and influence across teams to drive alignment and execution in a fast-paced environment

Why Work at Symetra

Here’s what some of our employees have to say about why they work at Symetra:

“I chose Symetra because I heard it was a pro-employee company—and it’s absolutely true. The work environment is supportive, the people are great, and the benefits are generous. Symetra truly cares about its employees. The relaxed atmosphere and opportunities to learn and grow—both within your role and beyond—make it a great place to build your career.” - Alicia L., Claims Examiner

"Symetra cares about doing what's right for their customers and that we have a great culture." - Jackie B., Regional Account Manager

What we offer you

Benefits and Perks

We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.

  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
  • Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
  • Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
  • Want more details? Check out ourSymetra Benefits Overview

Compensation

Salary Range: $171,300 - $285,600 plus eligibility for the company annual bonus program.

Who You Are:

  • You have a high school diploma (required), plus a Bachelor's degree in a related field.
  • 12–15 years of cumulative, relevant experience in product management, infrastructure, and/or engineering environments
  • Deep expertise in AWS and strong knowledge of the engineering and infrastructure landscape
  • Experienced in building structure and processes in evolving environments
  • Skilled at creating and refining user stories, with a clear understanding of what drives organizational value
  • Proven people leader with experience directly managing a team
  • Straightforward and transparent communicator who provides clear, direct feedback
  • Self-aware—confident in areas of expertise and comfortable asking questions when needed
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and execution
  • Data-driven decision maker who uses insights to guide priorities and outcomes
  • Some minimal annual travel required (for people manager roles only)

Travel:

  • Required Training & Professional Development
    All newly hired people leaders with direct reports are required to complete a comprehensive leadership development program within their first year. This program includes both virtual and in-person training. The in-person sessions will take place at Symetra’s corporate headquarters in Bellevue, Washington. Symetra covers all travel and accommodation expenses.
  • Reasonable Accommodations
    Symetra is committed to providing equitable access to all job-related responsibilities, including required travel. If reasonable accommodation is needed for travel, Symetra’s HR department will work to provide appropriate solutions in alignment with individual needs and company policies.
We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.
Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we're guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they're buying, and we design products--and operate our company--to stand the test of time. We're committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.
For more information about our careers visit:
Work Authorization
Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.
Please review Symetra's Remote Network Minimum Requirements:
As a remote-first organization committed to providing a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees' internet connection:
  • Minimum Internet Speed:100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, in alignment with the FCC's definition of "broadband."
  • Internet Type:Fiber, Cable (e.g., Comcast, Spectrum), or DSL.
  • Not Permissible:Satellite (e.g., Starlink), cellular broadband (hotspot or otherwise), any other wireless technology, or wired dial-up.
When applying to jobs at Symetra you'll be asked to test your internet speed and confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra's standard as outlined above.

Identity Verification

Symetra is committed to fair and secure hiring practices. For all roles, candidates will be required (after the initial phone screen) to be on video for all interviews. Symetra will take affirmative steps at key points in the process to verify that a candidate is not seeking employment fraudulently, e.g. through use of a false identity.
Failure to comply with verification procedures may result in:
  • Disqualification from the recruitment process
  • Withdrawal of a job offer
  • Termination of employment and other criminal and/or civil remedies, if fraud is discovered

We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:
The Insider Risk Analyst is a member of CrowdStrike’s Global Security team and plays a key role in operating and advancing the Insider Risk Program. Serving as the lead Insider Risk Analyst for the EMEA region, you will identify, assess, and help mitigate sophisticated internal and external threats to CrowdStrike’s people, assets, customers, and reputation. You will work closely with partners across Information Security, Human Resources, Legal, Information Technology, and other business functions to investigate concerns, manage risk, and strengthen protective measures. We are looking for a creative, collaborative, and motivated security professional with an interest in insider risk, investigations, counterintelligence, risk management, and national security.

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as the lead Insider Risk analyst for the EMEA region, supporting regional matters and broader Global Security priorities.

  • Identify, assess, and communicate potential threats, vulnerabilities, and risks involving CrowdStrike’s workforce, information, systems, and operations.

  • Conduct detailed and impartial investigations, including employee interviews, evidence analysis, documentation, and preparation of clear findings and recommendations.

  • Brief identified risks and investigative findings to stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

  • Develop and implement practical risk mitigation strategies, including security and insider risk awareness materials, newsletters, case studies, briefings, and targeted communications.

  • Lead outreach and risk management initiatives in partnership with Information Security, Human Resources, Legal, Information Technology, and other business functions.

  • Monitor relevant industry, threat, legal, and regulatory developments and help integrate applicable insights into Insider Risk and Global Security processes.

  • Deliver Insider Risk and other Security training to employees in the region.

What You’ll Need:

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in insider threat or insider risk, intelligence analysis, corporate security, investigations, government security, risk management, or a related field.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience conducting interviews, writing investigative reports, and presenting complex issues to varied audiences.

  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to assess sensitive situations and develop proportionate, practical recommendations.

  • Familiarity with insider risk principles, investigative practices, cybersecurity concepts, and the ways people, processes, and technology intersect within a security program.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote, global environment while building trusted relationships across teams, functions, and organisational levels.

  • Proficiency in open-source intelligence research and familiarity with threat intelligence, investigative, or security-related tools.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience within government, military, intelligence, law enforcement, defence contracting, or another national security environment.

  • Applied experience conducting insider risk, fraud, counterintelligence, corporate security, or other complex investigations.

  • Applied experience developing and delivering security education, training, awareness campaigns, or workforce communications.

  • Working knowledge of UK, European, or other global employment, privacy, and data protection considerations.

  • Experience working within a global tech organisation.

raw.excerpt: Media buying has changed. In 2026, a great media buyer is not just a button pusher.
raw.description:
Media buying has changed.

In 2026, a great media buyer is not just a button pusher. They understand the full system: creative, offer, conversion rate, platform dynamics, competition, and what to test next.

At Sweat Pants Agency, we are hiring a performance media buyer who can drive growth across Meta ads for DTC and ecommerce brands.

This role is for someone who can run paid media and also think like a marketer.

You will build testing roadmaps, guide creative strategy, communicate with clients, and help us scale what works.

If you've built or scaled your own eCommerce brand, we want to hear from you.

If you love following SOPs and repeating the same campaign structure forever, this is not the job.

If you love thinking, testing, and building frameworks that win, keep reading.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Own paid media strategy for DTC/eCommerce clients across Meta and TikTok
  • Build creative testing roadmaps — develop angles, write briefs for editors, analyze what's working
  • Manage ad budgets ranging from $30k / mo to $1m / mo per client
  • Diagnose the full funnel — spot whether issues are creative, offer, or conversion
  • Communicate clearly with clients — present results, plans, and next steps
  • Work with UGC creators — source talent, write scripts, direct content when needed

You're A Great Fit If...

You have hands-on experience scaling eCommerce brands:

  • You've managed Meta Ads with real spend and can show results (CPA, ROAS, revenue)
  • Bonus: You've built/operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand

You understand creative is the lever:

  • You can pull insights from reviews, competitor ads, and comments to generate new angles
  • You've written UGC scripts or creative briefs
  • You can work with editors to create winning ad variations
  • Video editing or design skills are a plus

You're a strategist, not a robot:

  • You challenge assumptions and adapt fast
  • You don't blindly follow "best practices"
  • You can explain what you're doing and why

You have ownership and urgency:

  • You act like it's your money
  • You move fast and follow through
  • You don't wait to be told what to do

Benefits

Why This Role Is Exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

  • Ability to travel 30%+

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

Position Summary

A second-level support role involves diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues that have been escalated from the first level of support. This role requires advanced knowledge of hardware, software, and networks. Key responsibilities include advanced troubleshooting, managing escalated tickets, providing technical guidance to junior staff, and documenting solutions.

The Helpdesk Technician – Tier II plays a crucial role within the Help Desk, acting as a critical escalation point. This role is instrumental in driving operational excellence by ensuring compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and providing a high-touch customer experience. Additionally, the Helpdesk Technician – Tier II collaborates seamlessly with the Infrastructure team to optimize the end-user technology ecosystem and maintain business continuity across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot complex issues by diagnosing, resolving or providing root-cause analysis of incidents across complex hardware, software, and network platforms.
  • Receive, prioritize, and manage support ticket workflows in the ITSM systems, ensuring alignment with SLA/OLA thresholds and proactive communication with departments regarding service impacts.

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Location: Remote in USA

Job Summary:

As the Principal Architect for the AI & Agentic Stack, you are a high-impact consultative leader and trusted advisor responsible for the architectural integrity of our enterprise AI solutions. Your mission is to translate vision and complex business requirements into detailed technical blueprints for model selection, API & data orchestration, and agentic logic. You act as a key bridge between sales and delivery, working closely with customers and Google channel partners to design scalable, governed, and high-performing systems leveraging Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI.

Responsibilities

  • Consultative Solutioning & Sales Support: Partner with sales to lead technical discovery, perform value-engineering, and design tailored AI architectures that solve specific client business challenges in high-stakes pursuits.

  • Technical Blueprinting & Delivery Oversight: Design end-to-end architectures for complex AI systems (RAG, multi-agent systems) and provide technical governance during implementation to ensure delivery aligns with original architectural intent.

  • Customer & Channel Technical Liaison: Act as a subject matter expert for clients and Google's technical field teams, coordinating joint-innovation pursuits and ensuring alignment with the latest Gemini and Vertex AI roadmaps.

  • Gemini Enterprise & Agentic Design: Lead the configuration of the Gemini Enterprise platform and architect agentic systems with advanced prompt engineering, iterative behavioral tuning, and robust human-in-the-loop oversight.

  • Prompt Engineering & System Tuning: Develop and optimize advanced prompt strategies for the Gemini ecosystem, balancing autonomy and specific behavioral goals through iterative tuning and system instructions.

  • MLOps & Data Governance: Define standards for MLOps and data orchestration, ensuring AI models are securely integrated with corporate data estates and comply with GCP best practices.

  • Technical Quality Control: Perform deep-dive architectural reviews of AI projects to ensure adherence to Google Cloud best practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • 12+ years in technical architecture with a focus on AI, Data, Integration, and consultative leadership

  • Expert-level knowledge of Gemini Enterprise (formerly Agent space), Vertex AI, and Big Query ML

  • Proven experience in customer-facing roles, with the ability to influence CXO stakeholders and lead technical solutioning for AI-driven business transformations

  • Proven experience in Prompt Design & Engineering (ideally with Gemini) and tuning LLM-based systems for specific behaviors and safety constraints

  • Deep understanding of Python-based AI orchestration (Lang Graph, ADK, etc.)

Desired Qualifications:

  • Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.

  • Experience with high-performance computing (HPU/TPU) and specialized AI hardware on GCP

We are seeking a Principal Solution Delivery Manager to serve as a Release Train Engineer (RTE) within the Workplace Solutions Agile Release Trains (ARTs). This role is a senior-level project management position responsible for leading large, complex initiatives in a Scaled Agile (SAFe) environment. You will ensure strong alignment, coordination, and predictable outcomes across multiple teams while driving both successful delivery and continuous improvement in how work flows through the system.

As an RTE for Workplace Solutions, you will lead mission-critical programs that span five or more teams and multiple business and technology partners. You will be accountable for end-to-end planning and execution, including managing scope, dependencies, risks, timelines, and delivery outcomes. You will guide ART-level planning and execution, ensuring work is aligned to strategic priorities and delivered in a way that balances speed, quality, and value. This role requires strong project and program management discipline combined with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, Agile environment.

This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business-critical meetings.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications)
      • I/S Principal Solution Delivery Manager: $130,000 - $140,000, plus 15% annual bonus opportunity
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead large, complex initiatives within the Workplace Solution ART, serving as a Release Train Engineer for an Agile Release Train or program supporting five or more stable teams.
  • Own end-to-end delivery planning and execution across run, grow, and transform work, ensuring alignment to strategic objectives.
  • Partner closely with Product Management, Technology Leadership, and business stakeholders to identify outcomes, manage dependencies, and mitigate risks.
  • Drive delivery predictability through strong planning, transparency, and proactive issue and risk management.
  • Tailor delivery and execution practices to fit the complexity of the work, avoiding one-size-fits-all approaches and serving as the process expert for applicable approaches including PMBOK, Scrum, predictive, hybrid, XP, and Kanban.
  • Facilitate large-scale planning, ART optimization, critical path planning sessions, and other critical collaboration discussions, as needed.
  • Use data and real-world insights to identify improvement opportunities and increase flow, throughput, and value delivery.
  • Serve as delivery system thought leader through coaching, facilitation, and hands-on support across teams and leaders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts across the ART and broader delivery ecosystem.
  • Promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • 5+ years of experience leading complex programs with an annual internal labor cost exceeding $5 million, successfully managing dependencies and delivery across 5+ Agile teams, along with 5-10 years of combined project and/or program management experience in increasingly progressive technology roles.
  • Ability to obtain PMP + RTE or SPC (SAFe Program Consultant) + Kanban certification within 18 months of hire. Demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development and Agile maturity.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Related field of study (Business Administration/Management Information Systems) or equivalent internal experience.
  • Ability to analyze large datasets with multiple abstract and concrete variables, drawing actionable insights to optimize program performance. Demonstrated expertise in risk management, problem-solving, and influencing key stakeholders to drive outcomes.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams, advocating for change, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and adaptability. Strong coaching skills to empower teams and individuals, creating an environment of trust, collaboration, and innovation.
  • Excellent critical thinking and influencing skills. An ability to collaborate across disciplines and communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Demonstrated professional agility in planning, monitoring, managing scope and dependencies, resourcing, ensuring quality, maintaining communication, managing risk, and controlling costs.
  • Ability to use data-driven analysis to recommend improvements to ART (Agile Release Train)/area performance and large-scale delivery.
  • Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States or Puerto Rico.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience serving as a Release Train Engineer, Solution Train Engineer, or equivalent large-scale delivery leadership role
  • Deep experience with group insurance products, including expertise in customer needs, business processes, value streams, and supporting systems and technologies
  • Strong understanding of group insurance benefit administration platforms, their roles in the market, and how they integrate with insurance carriers to support seamless delivery and client satisfaction
  • Insight into group insurance customers and operational dynamics, enabling strategic decision-making and solution design that meets evolving market and client demands, including maintaining up-to-date knowledge of the project management of emerging technologies, including API integration and modern system architectures and experience project managing the integration of new digital tools with legacy backend systems.
  • Advanced Agile certifications such as C.S.M. (Certified Scrum Master), PMI-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner), or Certified DevOps Practitioner.
  • Additional SAFe certifications (SA, SSM, SP) to support scaled Agile and continuous delivery initiatives.
  • Continuing professional education (20 hours annually) and/or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management Information Systems, or related fields.

The Role

We are looking for a high-potential commercial attorney to join our legal team. This person will initially focus on data-licensing agreements, inbound technology transactions, marketing and procurement contracts, and a broad range of other commercial matters.

The ideal candidate has exceptional academic credentials, strong foundational legal training, and a demonstrated ability to move quickly. Experience with intellectual property and data licensing is valuable, but we care most about strong commercial-contracting fundamentals and the ability to work effectively with a broad range of internal stakeholders in a very fast paced, fluid environment.

This is an opportunity for an ambitious attorney who wants to grow alongside a rapidly scaling company. We expect this person to develop expertise in new areas of the business, take on increasingly sophisticated matters, and materially expand their remit as their capabilities and the needs of the company grow.

What You’ll Do

  1. Draft, review, and negotiate complex data licensing, technology, marketing, procurement, SaaS, vendor, services, partnership, and NDA agreements.
  2. Own commercial matters end-to-end, from intake and issue spotting through negotiation and execution.
  3. Partner with internal teams to translate legal and contractual risk into clear, business-oriented recommendations.
  4. Develop a deep understanding of the company’s products, business model, technical environment, and data flows.
  5. Navigate novel legal and commercial questions with limited precedent, exercising strong judgment around when to make a call and when to escalate.
  6. Build and improve contract templates, negotiation playbooks, fallback positions, and self-service resources that help the business move faster.
  7. Identify opportunities to streamline legal operations through AI-enabled contract review, intake, automation, and knowledge management.
  8. Help shape scalable legal processes as the company and its commercial relationships grow in complexity.

What We’re Looking For

  1. Juris Doctor (JD) and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  2. Strong academic credentials and foundational legal training.
  3. Significant experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial and technology agreements, particularly involving data, software, technology, or intellectual property.
  4. Excellent legal judgment and the ability to distinguish between theoretical risk and risk that materially impacts the business.
  5. Ability to quickly understand technical products, business models, and unfamiliar legal areas.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a high bar for clarity and precision.
  7. Strong intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to develop expertise in emerging areas.
  8. High ownership and comfort operating independently in a fast-moving, highly asynchronous environment.

Nice to Have

  1. Experience at a top-tier law firm focused on technology transactions, commercial agreements, or IP.
  2. Experience with data licensing, artificial intelligence, privacy, or data protection.
  3. Familiarity with legal issues surrounding AI systems, data rights, permitted use, and emerging technology.
  4. Experience working with a venture-backed technology company, AI company, or other high-growth environment.
  5. Hands-on experience using AI or automation to improve legal workflows.

We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. Summary

This Senior Solution Consultant provides pre-sales support in the development and presentation of our Governance, Risk, and Compliance solutions to address the complex problems that Workiva's platform helps solve. The qualified candidate will be able to offer GRC subject matter expertise and technical fluency to the sales function, supporting business and technical conversations through discovery, technical qualification, roadmap-aligned selling, architecture discussions, product demonstrations, and communication of value-based messaging about the Workiva platform. This role will serve as the strategic technical presales partner for our Public Sector sales team, which includes Federal, States, Local, Special Districts, Higher Education, and Nonprofit Healthcare. Additionally, the job requires development and demonstration of example solutions, prototypes, and proofs of concept across current, emerging, and AI-enabled Workiva capabilities to validate solution fit, demonstrate customer value, and help secure the Technical Win.

What You’ll Do

  • Apply Workiva’s pre-sales frameworks, including Demo2Win and MEDDIC, to drive discovery, lead product demonstrations, respond to RFPs, engage customers and partners, and align Workiva solutions to customer needs

  • Demonstrate expertise across Workiva’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance solutions - developing working knowledge of Public Sector industries, departments, and use cases where Workiva can have an impact

  • Partner with Sales to develop account plans, support technical qualification, inform forecasting, and shape deal strategy in alignment with Workiva goals and objectives

  • Conduct process assessments with customers, build Proof of Concepts to validate requirements, build and present partner-specific business cases

  • Ensure customer success by working with implementation partners and Workiva Client Services team for smooth onboarding and long-term success

  • Assist in developing new use cases or by using existing templates, providing proof of our solution's impact and value proposition

  • Demonstrate AI fluency by using AI to improve presales execution and responsibly positioning Workiva’s AI capabilities with prospects and users

  • Stay current on new Workiva products, roadmap capabilities, platform enhancements, and market trends to support roadmap selling and demonstrate current and emerging capabilities

  • Work with Sales, Product Marketing, Client Services, Scoping, and Customer Success to achieve team and company goals

  • Maintain strong presales documentation and business process discipline, including deal notes, Technical Win updates, opportunity support, expenses, and required enablement

  • Represent Workiva confidently at marketing events, webinars, conferences, speaking engagements, and other onsite and virtual client-facing settings

  • May begin to deliver cross-domain coaching, training, or mentoring peers

What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Requires a minimum of 6 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 4 years and a Master’s degree; or 2 years and a PhD

  • GRC knowledge is valuable in this role. Candidates should either bring existing expertise or demonstrate strong aptitude and commitment to rapidly developing deep domain expertise

  • Experience in the Public Sector space, which could include Federal, States, Local, Special Districts, Higher Education and Nonprofit Healthcare

Preferred Qualifications

  • SaaS experience, with strong preference for candidates with GRC SaaS expertise (PreSales, implementation, consulting, etc.)

  • Experience in Big 4 consulting

  • Capability to gather business needs and present a value-based, compelling software demonstration

  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Self-motivated with strong propensity for action, results, and continuous improvement

  • Ability to solve problems and articulate solutions to business problems with strong communication and presentation skills

  • Experience engaging with and presenting to business or IT managers and executives, including CISO or infrastructure audiences

  • Hands-on technical experience with SaaS solutions, cloud technologies, and architectures

  • Experience with high-level technical aspects of connectivity and integration (API)

  • AI fluency, including the ability to use AI tools to improve presales execution and responsibly position AI capabilities with customers

  • Experience building processes from the ground up, including design, proposal, and cross-functional alignment

  • Experience applying structured selling or demonstration frameworks, such as Demo2Win, MEDDIC, or similar methodologies

  • Experience supporting Technical Win validation, including decision criteria, solution fit, risks, blockers, and next steps

  • Experience supporting customer-facing events, webinars, conferences, roadshows, speaking engagements, or strategic demonstrations

  • Experience proactively collaborating with and providing feedback to product management teams to capture new customer requirements and enhancements; may require guidance as needed

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Up to 40% Travel

  • Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, not in a Workiva office

Workiva will not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a permanent basis.

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ On Target Earnings (OTE) range in the US: 156,000.00 - 255,000.00 USD Annual

✅ Eligible for commission based on sales performance

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

Manager role performs a wide range of duties relating to the origination of residential mortgage loans for Financial Centers and outside referrals. The DevOps Sr Manager sits within the Platform Engineering organization and is a working manager role, spending roughly half of their time in leadership and the other half hands-on engineering. This role provides leadership to the DevOps team while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and on-call. Partners closely with development, data platform, data governance, and IT teams to deliver secure, reliable, and cost-effective platform capabilities.

This is a remote role; however, we currently operate in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX and WI.

  • Comfort operating as both a leader and a builder, with strong judgment on when to delegate and when to dive in
  • Ability to translate technical decisions into business-friendly language for executive stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including documentation discipline

This role will focus on driving the integration of Qolo's payment processing and treasury management capabilities into CSI Digital Banking solutions while ensuring alignment with CSI's broader digital banking strategy. Working closely with technology, design, business stakeholders, customers, and cross-functional teams, you will help shape the future of business banking experiences through innovative payment and treasury management solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery of business banking and treasury management capabilities within CSI Digital.

  • Lead the integration of Qolo products and services into CSI's digital banking ecosystem, including alignment with future Apiture initiatives.

  • Develop detailed epics, features, and user stories that clearly define customer needs, business requirements, personas, and user journeys.

  • Partner with customers, beta programs, user groups, and industry events to gather feedback and influence product direction.

  • Support annual customer conferences, product demonstrations, and customer-facing discussions as needed.

  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams across CSI Digital, Payments, Core Banking, Apiture, and Qolo.

  • Support governance, risk management, business continuity, and compliance activities for assigned products.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The Opportunity

As our Marketing Operations Analyst in Revenue Operations (RevOps), you’ll be the data-driven partner aligning marketing, sales, and customer success to drive revenue. Your focus will be to measure, analyze, and optimize the customer lifecycle, particularly in new and expansion revenue outcomes from prospects and buying intent signals identified via marketing data suite.

You’ll utilize marketing technology, our Hubspot CRM, and enrichment tools, build dashboards to drive strategic decision making, analyze campaigns, and ensure smooth lead-to-sale handoffs to improve operational efficiency and marketing ROI. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role with direct impact on marketing and revenue outcomes in a fast-growing, international SaaS B2B environment in EdTech.
