Data Analysis & Performance Reporting

  • Partner with the VP of Revenue Operations to design, implement, and evolve the RevOps data model for marketing.
  • Track marketing performance, funnel metrics, and lifecycle outcomes to connect activity to pipeline, revenue, adoption, and expansion. Ensure consistent definition and application of these key terms and metrics.
  • Build dashboards, generate insights, and provide recommendations to guide marketing programs and decision-making.
  • Conduct spotlight analysis to support strategic initiatives, such as segmentation, partnerships, and international market exploration.

Lead Management & Routing

  • Manage lead scoring, routing, and attribution models to ensure high-quality MQLs are delivered to commercial teams at the right time and stage with the right supporting data.
  • Ensure smooth lead-to-sales handoffs through clearly defined lifecycle stages, SLAs, and feedback loops between marketing, sales, and customer success.

Process Optimization

  • Drive continuous improvement of marketing and RevOps processes.
  • Identify workflow gaps and implement better processes, automation, and alignment across teams.
  • Partner with GTM leadership to define and scale repeatable operating models for multi-region growth initiatives.

Tech Stack Management

  • Configure, connect, and optimize HubSpot and marketing automation platforms.
  • Ensure clean data, scalable system configuration, and reliable integration across marketing, sales, and analytics tools.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4–8 years of experience in marketing analytics, RevOps, or growth analytics in B2B SaaS (PLG experience is a plus).
  • Experience across the full customer lifecycle: acquisition, activation, adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • Proven ability to link marketing activity to pipeline, revenue, and lifecycle outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing high-visibility projects with diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Hands-on with HubSpot, marketing automation workflows, enrichment tooling and BI tools (Hex, Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Experience contributing to RevOps data models, attribution frameworks, and KPIs.
  • Comfortable partnering with senior stakeholders and translating data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Strong understanding of lead management, scoring, routing, and handoffs. Experience driving consensus, iteration and enablement around lead enrichment and routing dynamics.
  • Thrives in a fast-moving, international SaaS environment, balancing rigor with pragmatism.
  • SQL skills preferred.
  • Clay and n8n experience preferred.

Why Kami?

We’re building a high performance, best in class team to help capitalize on our exciting momentum, and continue scaling Kami's magic and making a difference to schools, students, and teachers. With Kami, you’ll have

  • A people-first employer that is on an inspiring mission to build the future of education while changing the lives of millions
  • High calibre and diverse team ranging from successful startup veterans, to Fortune 500 and big tech professionals
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities, including subsidised course fees, certifications, conferences, and free access to Udemy and more
  • A strong mission; the satisfaction of knowing you’re not only helping modern-day superheroes, aka teachers but also helping them shape the minds of future generations all across the globe
  • Happy customers: Helping thousands of schools worldwide through the digital transformation of education for the 21st century. Just read our reviews.
  • Huge potential: Already used by 70M users in 175 countries. One of the most popular and fastest-growing EdTech platforms worldwide.

If you’re looking for a new challenge and the opportunity to impact the lives of millions, apply now!

micro1 is engaging Software Engineers to contribute their technical expertise to a customer-centric project focused on enhancing development workflows and process automation. Scope of Work

  4. Fluency with major enterprise SaaS platforms such as Slack, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365; administrative experience in cloud workspaces is advantageous.

raw.title: Strengthening SUNCASA Evidence for GESI-Responsive Urban Nature-based Solutions:
raw.excerpt: BackgroundThe Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) project aims to enhance climate resilience, gender equality, social inclusion (GESI), and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda), and Johannesburg (South Africa).
raw.description:
Background

The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) project aims to enhance climate resilience, gender equality, social inclusion (GESI), and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda), and Johannesburg (South Africa). This initiative is led by the International Institute for Sustainable Development (IISD) in partnership with the World Resources Institute, together with local partners. The main objective of SUNCASA is to address climate-induced risks (e.g., floods, landslides, and soil erosion) by implementing GESI-responsive nature-based solutions (NbS). This is aimed at strengthening the resilience of urban communities, watersheds, and biodiversity from the impacts of climate change, while reducing barriers to NbS participation among women and the underrepresented groups. This would be achieved through targeted interventions such as afforestation and reforestation programs, agroforestry, urban greening, and establishment of vegetated buffer zones in affected areas. The project was launched in late 2023, and implementation will be completed by late 2026.

Despite growing interest and investment in urban NbS, relatively little evidence exists regarding how gender-responsive approaches to NbS influence project effectiveness, sustainability, governance, and equity outcomes. Gender-responsive approaches to NbS under SUNCASA are actions to protect, sustainably manage, and restore natural or modified ecosystems that address and challenge gender and social inequalities to promote equity, justice, and inclusion. This intersectional approach also considers diverse knowledge systems, including local knowledge, that result in equitable benefits from decision making and participation in NbS.

As the project nears completion, SUNCASA offers a unique opportunity to strengthen the evidence base on how GESI-responsive NbS contribute to larger climate adaptation and biodiversity protection outcomes in urban contexts. To this end, IISD seeks to engage an external monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) consultancy team to conduct a theory-based end-of-project evaluation to assess progress toward achieving selected SUNCASA outcomes.

The evaluation will employ theory-based mixed methods, such as key informant interviews (KIIs) and focus group discussions (FGDs) for different sets of actors from each city. Deliverables of this opportunity will include a final external evaluation report (reporting against select outcomes) and communications products to showcase SUNCASA’s early impact/outcomes. Given the short project timeline of 3 years, this evaluation will focus on assessing evidence that supports the pathways of change hypothesized by SUNCASA and early signs of impact and sustainability from the project rather than looking for long-term impacts or effectiveness.

This RFP outlines the scope, objectives, and deliverables for engaging a MEL consultancy team for evaluation data collection and final deliverables.

Objective of the Assignment

This evaluation will assess the end-of-project progress toward achievement of selected SUNCASA intermediate and immediate outcomes that targeted decision-makers and local implementing partners participating in the project. Using mixed methods, a theory-based final evaluation report (including thematic case studies as part of the final report) will be developed to assess SUNCASA’s achievements in reaching selected outcomes. This assignment also requests an interim 2-pager communications product prepared to illustrate the early results and lessons from SUNCASA based on the evaluation, to support discussions at key events taking place in October/November 2026. Lastly, a shorter report will also be developed to showcase high-level results from the final report. Specifics regarding the assignment deliverables are provided in Section 3 of this RFP.

The 2-pager has a specific objective, audience and timeline intended for distribution at the Conference of the Parties to the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD COP). This deliverable will be developed first based on validated high-level, available results, with the final report and derived version to be completed at the end of the assignment. Therefore, the assignment includes a total of three (3) written deliverables, as outlined in Section 7 of this RFP. Appendix A presents the list of outcomes to be evaluated and proposed evaluation questions. The consultancy team is expected to review and revise the evaluation questions in collaboration with the IISD team prior to finalizing the evaluation.

As the SUNCASA project has existing quantitative and qualitative data sources, the consultancy team can use existing SUNCASA data as secondary data sources. Existing data includes

• NbS monitoring data (quarterly data on hectares restored, trees and buffer zone plants planted, debris removal, etc.);
• household-level perceived socio-economic and adaptive capacity data (final survey results from community stakeholders);
• community- and household-level stories of change (qualitative one-pagers from participating NbS workers and community members impacted by SUNCASA);
• training participation numbers and pre- and post-raining evaluation results;
• additional project monitoring and learning records across implementation sites as relevant

Tasks and Deliverables

The expected tasks and deliverables for each assignment component are outlined below:

Component 1: Inception report and evaluation design

  • Review project documentation, existing data sets, MEL framework, and relevant literature.
  • Participate in onboarding sessions with IISD and partners.
  • Refine evaluation questions, sampling approach, and methodology.
  • Develop an inception report detailing the proposed approach.

Deliverable 1: Inception report, including:

  • Refined evaluation questions
  • Data collection plan
  • Detailed workplan and timeline
  • Proposed communications/fundraising product (i.e., CBD COP deliverable) and case study ideas

Component 2: Develop data collection and analytical tools and incorporate feedback from inception report

  • Revise tools based on IISD feedback.
  • Develop and finalize data collection tools (KIIs, FGDs).

Deliverable 2: Final data collection tools

Component 3: Conduct in-country data collection across all three cities (Johannesburg, Kigali, and Dire Dawa). The consultancy team will coordinate with local IISD staff regarding participant time and logistics.

  • KIIs
  • FGDs

Deliverable 3: Completion of data collection activities, shared cleaned data (anonymized)

Component 4: Analysis and draft reporting. Analyze primary and secondary evidence to:

  • Develop one draft final evaluation report
  • Develop a two-pager with high-level results (communications piece intended for distribution at the CBD COP). This deliverable is time sensitive and due before the conference begins on October 19.

Deliverable 4: CBD COP two-pager

Deliverable 5: Draft final evaluation report

Component 5: Validation and finalization

  • Final report submitted with revisions applied based on feedback
  • Final derived shortened version submitted

Deliverable 6: Final evaluation report

Deliverable 7: Final shortened evaluation report

The table below presents the proposed dates for each deliverable as a basis for work planning.

Read the full Terms of Reference here

Strengthening SUNCASA Evidence for GESI-Responsive Urban Nature-based Solutions: End-of-project evaluation

Application deadline: August 14, 2026

Application Process

All applications must be submitted in English.

To be considered for this opportunity, interested qualified consultancy teams must submit the following documents in English, using an easy-to-read font (minimum 10-point size). The documents must be submitted electronically in PDF format.

Proposals should include the following:

  • Cover letter outlining the relevant professional experience of proposed consultants, including the availability for the assignment. The Cover Letter should also identify the primary contact person and include their contact details.
  • Technical Proposal (maximum 15 pages, excluding CVs) demonstrating understanding of the assignment and proposed approach to undertake the work, including the methodology, work plan, and timeline. The proposed work plan must align with the deliverables and timeline set out in Section 4.
  • Detailed CVs of all proposed consultants (submitted as an appendix to the proposal) highlighting relevant professional experience conducting evaluations of a similar scope and complexity.
  • Financial Proposal must be presented in USD and include the proposed daily rates for the consultant(s) and any additional costs associated with this assignment. All costs must be clearly itemized, aligned with each deliverable outlined in Section 4, and consistent with the scope of work described in this RFP. A separate Budget Narrative must be included to provide additional detail and justification for each budget line item.
  • At least two (2) project profiles highlighting the consultancy team’s past experience conducting evaluations of a similar scope and complexity. For each project profile, include the evaluation scope, project duration, team composition (including number of team members and their respective roles), geographic location(s), brief description of the project, and a description of the actual services provided by the team. Where applicable, indicate the client’s name and the year the assignment was completed.

About African Safari Group

African Safari Group is a luxury inbound safari travel company, connecting high-net-worth clients form the UK, EU, USA, Australia and New Zealand with world-class safari experiences across South, Southern and Eastern Africa.

We operate a custom-built CRM (Blaze), a suite of high-traffic destination websites, and an active AI and automation development programme. Technology is central to our growth strategy - we're building net generation booking infrastructure, AI agents, and data platforms that will shape how luxury travel is sold in Africa.

The Role

This is a rate dual-mandate role. You will lead out technology function - setting direction, making architecture decisions, an managing vendors and partners, while also being hands-on in the work.

With a lean team of two today, you can't just direct: you need to build, troubleshoot, solve problems and ship alongside your team.

You'll own everything from our custom CRM and server infrastructure to our AI and data projects. You'll be the person the CEO turns to when a new platform initiative needs scoping, a production issue needs diagnosing, or a technology investment needs a recommendation.

What you'll own

  • Blaze CRM - our custom built .Net/SQL CRM used by 100+ staff daily. Own its architecture, stability, enhancements and long-term roadmap.
  • Websites & servers - 20+ WordPress sites across multiple cloud servers (Cloudways, DigitalOcean and Linode). Own performance, uptime, infrastructure and security.
  • AI & Automation - lead active projects involving AI agents, data extraction, crawling and workflow automation using technologies such as OpenClaw, Claude and Python.
  • Rates & booking engine - oversee our PostgreSQL-backend rates extraction and quoting platform currently in active development.
  • Technology governance - establish standards across Node.js, PHP, Python, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare, Cady, systemd and related technologies, and ensure they are consistently applied.
  • Team leadership - manage, mentor and grow a small but capable technology team, while identifying future hiring requirements as the function scales.
  • Technology strategy - translate business requirements into practical technology solutions and ensure our systems can scale with ASG's growth.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering or systems architecture, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong hands-on full-stack or backend development capability (PHP, Python, Node.js or equivalent)
  • Proven experience managing Linux serves and cloud infrastructure (DigitalOcean, Linode or similar).
  • Strong database expertise particularly with PostgreSQL, and/or SQL Server.
  • A proven track record of leading small, high-output engineering teams.
  • The ability to operate strategically while remaining technically hands-on.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment.
  • Comfortable working directly with the CEO- structures thinker, commercially minded and clear communicator.

Strong Advantage

  • Experience with AI/LLM integration, AI agents, automation or data pipelines
  • Experience with WordPress or headless CMS environment at scale.
  • .NET or Windows Server experience, particularly in relation to our Blaze CRM environment
  • Experience with booking engines, travel technology, hospitality or other transaction-heavy platforms.
  • Experience taking technology products or platforms from development through to production.
  • Experience working in an environment where technology is a core part of business growth, rather than simply an internal support function.

What wont work

  • Pure strategists who haven't coded or worked hands on with technology in years
  • People who need a large team to be effective. We're looking for someone who can personally solve problems and build alongside the team.
  • Candidates who need everything fully defines. You should be comfortable identifying problems, proposing solutions and taking ownership from the idea through implementation.
  • Technology leaders ho operate in isolation. This role requires close collaboration with the CEO and the wider business.

Benefits

What you'll get

  • A sear at the leadership table with direct access to the CEO.
  • Genuine ownership of ASG's technology function and roadmap.
  • The opportunity to share a technology environment that is actively being built and scaled.
  • A front-row seat to how AI and automation are reshaping the luxury travel industry.
  • Significant autonomy to make architectural and technology decisions.
  • A clear path towards CTO as the technology function and business continue to scale.
  • A competitive package, discussed with shortlisted candidates.

The BusRight Vision

We believe public education creates freedom, and that access to that education starts with a safe and reliable ride to school. That’s why we built BusRight, a modern transportation platform trusted by hundreds of thousands of Transportation Directors, Drivers, and Parents across 36+ states to make school transportation safer, smarter, and more equitable.

Role Overview

Now more than ever, we recognize that Talent will have a disproportionate impact on the future of our business, as constantly evolving technological solutions make the human touch more important than ever. We’re ready to bring on board our first in-house HR Manager to grow the next generation of talent that will shape BusRight and the student transportation industry.

As BusRight’s HR Manager, you’ll create the systems, processes, and brand that power our next chapter by helping us attract, assess, and develop exceptional talent across every team. From GTM to Engineering, you’ll turn data and storytelling into a recruiting engine that’s scalable, human, and uniquely BusRight.

This is an opportunity for someone who’s entrepreneurial, disciplined, and energized by the challenge of scaling a fast growing tech company by influencing its most important driver of success: its people.

In this role, you’ll:

Take the lead in building the recruiting tools and frameworks that will shape the future of BusRight. You’ll partner directly with the CEO and his Leadership Team to define what great hiring looks like, craft a consistent and thoughtful candidate experience, and ensure BusRight scales with the right people in the right roles at the right time.

You’ll design the connection between hiring managers, candidates, and our culture, so that every new BusRighter embodies our mission and our belief that great people are the engine behind every mile on this journey.

Your Day-To-Day

  • Talent Acquisition (50%)
    • Lead the full recruiting journey across every department, from the first outreach to the final offer, ensuring every candidate experience reflects our core tenet of magical hospitality.
    • Build and maintain pipelines that keep us ahead of our hiring needs, nurturing relationships with exceptional talent even before new roles exist.
    • Create the recruiting infrastructure (e.g., tools, metrics, and rituals) that keeps our hiring transparent, efficient, and deeply aligned with our values.
    • Collaborate with Marketing and Leadership to bring BusRight’s employer brand to life through storytelling, events, and creative outreach that show who we are and why people love working here.
  • Talent Management (20%)
    • Partner with department heads to define excellence across functions, building structured, thoughtful expectations to drive high performance.
    • Help to author performance review philosophies and processes that feel personal, purposeful, and unmistakably BusRight.
  • Learning & Development (20%)
    • Create standardized, repeatable onboarding processes to ensure every new BusRighter gets up to speed quickly and has a valuable and productive experience from day one.
    • Help to identify critical needs across the organization and define best approaches by which to ensure that our employees are continuously developing their skills and capabilities.
  • Operations & Compliance (10%)
    • Manage all internal employee data and records, from personnel files to real-time organizational charts.
    • Write and maintain internal policies and procedures that ensure both compliance with state and federal legislation as well as consistent employee experience.

Requirements

About You

  • You’ve spent 4-7 years helping venture-backed, high-growth technology companies attract and retain great people.
  • You’ve partnered across every corner of the org (e.g., GTM, Product, Engineering) and you love figuring out what makes people value-additive to the organization.
  • You thrive in ambiguous situations and know how to operate in the “grey area” between problems and processes. You don’t require prescriptive direction and are motivated by the opportunity to propose novel solutions to challenges others haven’t yet addressed.
  • You’ve built (or rebuilt) playbooks, scorecards, and employee experiences that feel thoughtful and human. You’re just as comfortable mapping a performance management strategy as you are jumping into a sourcing sprint.
  • You communicate clearly, think systematically, and use strong judgment to make critical decisions.
  • You’re creative and entrepreneurial. You’d rather develop bespoke solutions than run the same play as the other team.
  • You’re tech-savvy and focused on relentless personal development, recognizing that technology only amplifies the importance of human capability.
  • Most of all, you’re humble, curious, and down to earth. You care about people, education, and building something that matters - and you want to help BusRight grow by finding the kind of teammates who care just as much.

This is a chance to join a fast growing technology company early and make your mark on a territory and a team that’s transitioning how millions of students access their education every day. If you're energized by growth and driven by relationships we’d love to hear from you.

We’re a remote team with hubs in New York City, Boston, Austin, and Poland. To get a feel for the team and culture, check out our company retreat in Mexico, thisBusRight commercial, and how we approach school bus conferences.

raw.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD94957

Position Overview

At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive.

Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experiencedSoftware Architectto join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it.

Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role.

The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma.

This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need.

Responsibilities

  • API Design & Evolution: Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract.

  • System Architecture: Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows.

  • Schema Design & Evolution: Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks.

  • Standards & Governance: Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews.

  • Prototyping & Feasibility: Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption.

  • Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams.

  • Reliability & Performance: Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging).

  • Communication: Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration.

  • Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience).

  • Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required.

  • Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management.

  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams.

  • Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders.

  • Ability to collaborate with a global team.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites.

Core:

  • Cloud Services: AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS).

  • Distributed Systems: Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design.

  • API & Service Design: REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation).

  • Database Architecture: Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL).

  • Observability/SRE: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services.

Bonus:

  • Semantic Technologies: Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM.

  • BIM Expertise: Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems.

  • AI Systems: RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering).

  • Domain-Specific AI for AEC: BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing.

  • Event-Driven Architectures: Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing.

  • AEC Domain Knowledge: Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided.

About the Team

The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data.

Why Join Us

  • Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company.

  • Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide.

  • Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio.

  • Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry.

  • Join a team that values technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here:


In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

Position Overview:
The Senior Compliance Systems Analyst supports compliance-related system and process initiatives by serving as the day-to-day subject matter resource for assigned regulatory areas. This role is responsible for evaluating regulatory requirements, conducting first-pass research and analysis, helping design how requirements should function within the loan origination system and related workflows, and supporting the implementation of compliance-related changes. This role serves as a compliance subject-matter expert for designated LOS functionality, helping to establish, maintain, and continuously improve system behavior in alignment with regulatory requirements and internal policies. The Senior Compliance Systems Analyst operates at a level above pure testing execution by owning assigned workstreams, drafting and refining requirements, coordinating with stakeholders, and helping move changes from analysis through implementation and validation. This role partners closely with Legal, Technology, Operations, and Compliance leadership to ensure requirements are translated into practical, compliant business and system behavior.

Job Responsibilities:
• Serve as the primary compliance subject matter resource for assigned regulatory areas (for example, TILA, RESPA, TRID, and the SAFE Act, among others) and act as the day-to-day owner of related analysis, requirements, testing support, and implementation activities.
• Evaluate regulatory requirements, investor guidance, overlays, and internal policy expectations to determine how they should be reflected in loan origination system functionality, operational workflows, disclosures, documents, and related controls.
• Conduct first-pass regulatory research and issue analysis, identify open questions or gray areas, and prepare work products for attorney or executive compliance review and sign-off.
• Translate regulatory and business requirements into clear business, system, and procedural requirements that Technology, Operations, and other stakeholders can understand and execute.
• Help design how regulatory requirements should function within the loan origination system, including rules, fields, logic, workflows, outputs, and related operational impacts.
• Own assigned compliance-related changes from initial analysis through implementation and validation.
• Partner with Technology teams, project resources, and business stakeholders to support implementation of approved compliance-related changes and help resolve questions that arise during design, build, and testing.
• Design and, when appropriate, execute test scenarios for assigned regulatory areas; review test results and defect findings; and identify gaps or issues requiring follow-up testing, requirement clarification, or escalation.
• Guide QA resources by clarifying expected behavior and refining test scenarios, while remaining directly involved in testing assigned regulatory areas to confirm that observed system behavior satisfies the underlying requirement.

  • Document requirements, interpretations, decisions, findings, and implementation outcomes in a clear and organized manner that supports audit, examination, and internal review needs.
    • Track open questions, exceptions, and dependencies related to assigned work and proactively follow through with stakeholders to keep items moving toward resolution.
    • Communicate clearly with Legal, Technology, Operations, and Compliance leadership regarding status, issues, risks, and recommendations for assigned initiatives.
    • Identify opportunities to improve processes, requirements templates, testing approaches, or documentation practices to strengthen the overall compliance change process.
    • Serve as the ongoing compliance owner for assigned LOS functionality, helping ensure rules, workflows, disclosures, and documents remain aligned with current regulatory requirements and internal policies.
    • Evaluate questions or concerns regarding existing compliance logic raised by internal stakeholders and, as applicable, external lenders, and determine whether clarification, additional testing, or updates are needed.
    • Support continuous improvement of LOS compliance by identifying enhancement opportunities, updating requirements, and partnering with stakeholders to implement and validate changes over time.

Qualifications and Skills:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combinations of education, training, professional certifications, and relevant experience.
• Relevant education, training, certifications, or experience in compliance, mortgage operations, business analysis, legal support, quality assurance, or a related field.
• Experience working with mortgage compliance requirements, investor guidelines, disclosures, loan documentation, and related operational processes.
• Experience working in mortgage operations, including applying regulatory requirements within day-to-day workflows, systems, and operational processes, preferred.
• Experience performing regulatory research, compliance analysis, requirements drafting, testing support, or implementation support within mortgage or financial services environments, preferred.
• Experience with loan origination systems (LOS), Jira, testing documentation, requirements documentation, and related workflow management or tracking tools, preferred.
• Comfortable collaborating across Compliance, Legal, Technology, Operations, and project teams to move work forward and resolve issues.
• Skilled in interpreting regulatory requirements and translating them into system logic, configuration, and workflow behavior within loan origination systems (LOS) and related mortgage technology platforms.
• Skilled in critical thinking and independent analysis, including identifying issues, evaluating information, developing reasoned recommendations, and determining when escalation or additional review is appropriate.
• Skilled in problem-solving, including analyzing incomplete, unclear, or evolving information and developing sound, practical solutions.
• Skilled in reviewing requirements, testing results, workflows, documentation, and implementation outcomes to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and areas requiring clarification.
• Excellent communication skills, including summarizing research, explaining findings, and documenting issues in a manner that supports Legal, Technology, and business stakeholders.
• Excellent organizational and follow-through skills, including coordinating and prioritizing multiple concurrent workstreams and deliverables.

About the team

The Shopping AI team is at the heart of Zillow Group’s mission to create a seamless digital real estate marketplace. We build and own the machine learning systems that power Zillow’s core user experiences—like personalized search, recommendations, and display optimization—across our apps and websites. Our close-knit group of engineers and scientists collaborates with product and design to apply the latest AI advancements, tackling large-scale challenges and shaping the future of home shopping at Zillow.

About the role

As an Applied Scientist, you will help drive the next generation of ranking, recommendation, and generative AI systems for Zillow’s home-shopping experience. Your work will directly impact how millions of users discover and shop for homes, as you research, design, and deploy innovative machine learning models that power key product features. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to deliver solutions that make home shopping more intuitive, personalized, and efficient.

You Will Get To

  • Research, design, and prototype new machine learning models for Zillow’s consumer products, including search, ranking, recommendations, and notifications.

  • Lead the full model lifecycle: from ideation and offline experimentation on large datasets to online deployment, A/B testing, and ongoing performance monitoring.

  • Develop and test novel modeling approaches, such as deep learning architectures and large language models (LLMs), to improve the home-shopping experience.

  • Apply cutting-edge AI techniques, including LLM-based retrieval and RAG-style systems, to create more natural and conversational property search experiences.

  • Optimize how and when homes are displayed to users, ensuring relevance and context in every interaction.

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to define, execute, and iterate on impactful projects.

  • Partner with data engineering and infrastructure teams to leverage large-scale distributed data systems for feature engineering and model training.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $136,300.00 - $217,700.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $129,500.00 - $206,900.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Experienced in designing, training, and analyzing machine learning models to solve real-world business problems, not just academic benchmarks.

  • Proficient in Python and familiar with common ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, CatBoost, scikit-learn, Hugging Face) and distributed data systems (e.g., Spark, Hive, Databricks, Airflow).

  • Skilled in the scientific lifecycle: hypothesis formation, experiment design, result analysis, and clear communication to technical and non-technical partners.

  • Demonstrated experience in at least one of the following: search/information retrieval, personalized ranking/recommender systems, or generative AI/LLM-based systems.

  • Holds a PhD or Master’s degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related), or equivalent industry experience (typically 3-4+ years with a Master’s, or 1+ year with a PhD).

  • Comfortable working near production systems and collaborating closely with engineers and cross-functional partners.

  • Brings curiosity and excitement for applying generative AI and LLMs to transform the home-shopping experience.

  • Approaches challenges with ownership, scientific rigor, and a growth mindset.

  • Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

raw.description:
Who Are We?

Xcelirate develops technologically-advanced platforms which are accessed by thousands of users every minute! We are proud to offer a workplace where the sharpest developers come together to strategically plan and swiftly execute practices which see us maintain our existing market dominance and attain global expansion. We owe our success to our customers who have seen us grow across a decade, and our talented team who have made that growth possible.

What are we looking for?

You're a Principal-Level Full-Stack Engineer. You haven't just been around the block - you helped decide which blocks were worth building, and which ones should've been bulldozed early.

At this point, programming languages don’t really impress you anymore. You treat them as tools that translate intent into something a compiler or interpreter can run, choosing them pragmatically, discarding them without nostalgia, and never confusing syntax or novelty with actual progress.

You’ve been around long enough to remember when PHP constructors shared their class names, when exceptions were returned instead of thrown, and when Yeoman, Underscore, and CoffeeScript felt like the obvious future. More importantly, you also learned when to stop using those awful, awful, creations.

Despite all that experience, you’ve stayed deeply hands-on, and you’ve never been particularly interested in drifting into management just because that seemed like the default next step. You’re still happiest close to the code.

You bring a distinctly stoic approach to your work. You don’t panic when systems misbehave, you don’t chase drama, and you don’t confuse urgency with importance.

When you join a project, things tend to settle down. Code becomes easier to reason about, systems start to feel calmer, and decisions get clearer. That sense of clarity tends to spread to the people around you, and without any formal mentoring process, they start picking things up simply by working alongside you.

You have a solid, intuitive understanding of hot-path optimization, speculative execution, and lazy initialization, and you’re occasionally surprised that these simple concepts aren’t more widely understood.

And the homelab experiments you keep running at home, purely because you’re curious and can’t help yourself? We definitely want to hear about those.

If reading this feels a little too familiar, this role is likely to be a very good fit.

What will you be doing?

  • Manage your own time while adhering to priorities set by the company.
  • Own complex engineering problems end-to-end, from problem framing and design through to delivery and iteration.
  • Take responsibility for critical areas of the platform, ensuring they remain reliable, performant, and maintainable.
  • Build new features and improve existing ones across our platforms.
  • Refactor legacy and modern codebases pragmatically, balancing long-term health with delivery needs.
  • Write tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) to ensure software reliability.
  • Be involved in every phase of the software lifecycle, from ideation to deployment.
  • Participate in (and at times lead) deep technical discussions, helping drive sound decisions and trade-offs.
  • Work hands-on across backend and frontend systems, stepping in wherever the problem lives.
  • Identify inefficiencies and help streamline workflows, reducing unnecessary work.
  • Collaborate closely with other senior engineers, raising the bar through example rather than authority
  • Take ownership of your work, ensuring high-quality results and maintainable solutions.

Requirements

What will you bring along?

  • 15+ years hands-on experience building and maintaining complex web applications
  • Clear technical communication; able to explain and defend design decisions to senior engineers and non-engineers alike
  • Expert PHP developer (12+ years); Symfony or equivalent frameworks
  • 10+ years modern JavaScript; React or Vue (Next/Nuxt a plus)
  • Expert level knowledge in at least one more programming language (Python a plus)
  • Full-stack architecture expertise: monoliths, services, and hybrids
  • Power user cloud deployment and scaling (AWS preferred) experience and abilities
  • Expert Linux user; including daily containerized workflows with Docker
  • Expert in infrastructure automation: Terraform, Ansible
  • Power user level CI/CD pipeline and release workflow ownership
  • Experience in automated testing: unit, integration, E2E; TDD where appropriate
  • Expert level knowledge in and around web security fundamentals: auth, authorization, data protection, secure coding
  • Legacy + modern codebase fluency; ability to work on incremental modernization
  • Strong independent technical ownership and accountability

We are always looking for the best candidates, so if you think you would be a good fit even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we would love to hear from you!

Benefits

How We Support Our Contractors

  • An annualised rate of €139,000 + retention bonus scheme: Competitive contractor rate with a generous bonus paid every 6 months based on your time with us.
  • Top-Notch Workstation: We provide the latest MacBook, branded merchandise, and everything you need for an optimal work environment.
  • Global Co-Working Access: Work from a global network of co-working spaces to keep your work-life dynamic and flexible.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy full flexibility in work location and hours, supporting a work-life balance tailored to your needs.
  • Events and Gatherings: Participate in exciting events throughout the year, including team gatherings, cultural events, and other fun activities.

Meet the Team

Cisco’s Global Enterprise Segment (GES) partners with the world’s most influential organizations as they navigate digital transformation and AI-driven innovation. The Collaboration team helps enterprise customers create intelligent workplace experiences and reimagine customer experience (CX) through Cisco’s industry-leading portfolio, including Webex Suite, Contact Center, Devices, and AI-powered workplace technologies.

Your Impact

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you will help customers deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences. You will guide them as they modernize their collaboration ecosystems, create intelligent workplace experiences, and put AI to work across their customer experience strategy. You will shape high-impact, strategic deal structures with commercial creativity across a defined set of Fortune 500 accounts, operating within a matrixed environment and partnering with internal account teams to drive growth and deliver measurable customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Deal Orchestration: Lead complex, large-scale deal cycles with a focus on deal creativity, commercial structuring, and aligning solutions to each customer’s strategic priorities. Build and maintain executive-level relationships that position Cisco as an essential partner in the customer’s workplace and customer experience transformation.
  • Workplace & CX Portfolio Growth: Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities across Webex Suite, Contact Center, and Devices, from intelligent workplace experiences to AI-powered customer experience solutions.
  • Matrixed Collaboration: Partner effectively with existing account teams, Solutions Engineers, and ecosystem partners to deliver customer outcomes. You will support a broader segment of accounts while maintaining deep focus on a select list of top-tier targets.
  • Outcome-Based Business Case Analysis: Develop financial business case analyses around workplace and customer experience outcomes, leveraging Cisco-provided AI tools to ensure customer engagements are impactful to the outcomes being explored.
  • AI Platform Fluency: Engage credibly in customer conversations about AI architecture, including how large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and interoperability standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) frameworks are shaping the modern workplace and CX stack. Articulate where Cisco’s portfolio fits within the customer’s broader AI strategy.
  • Thought Leadership and Best Practices: Serve as a thought leader and executive presenter on workplace and customer experience transformation. Capture what works in your deals and help establish best practices that can be leveraged across our teams.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of enterprise technology sales experience with a proven track record of structuring and closing large, complex deals.
  • 5+ years of experience selling collaboration, unified communications, contact center/CX, SaaS, cloud, or related workplace technology solutions.
  • Executive presence and deep industry credibility; experience competing against or working within major cloud and technology providers (e.g., AWS, Microsoft) is highly valued.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and navigating large, matrixed organizations.
  • Strong financial and business acumen; ability to build business cases around workplace and customer experience outcomes, structure creative commercial agreements, and use AI tools as a core part of the analysis.
  • Working knowledge of AI platform architecture, including large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and interoperability standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication. Deep technical expertise is not required, but you must be conversant enough to engage credibly with customer architects, AI leaders, and line-of-business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling enterprise SaaS platforms such as workplace collaboration, customer experience, CRM, or related business applications.
  • Proven ability to identify untapped opportunities and develop new business within existing enterprise footprints.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence C-suite executives and line-of-business stakeholders.
  • Strong executive presentation skills, with experience sharing thought leadership at customer briefings and industry events.
  • Ability to travel nationally to foster face-to-face executive relationships.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

raw.description:
Broadband Practice

Michael Baker International’s Broadband Practice provides broadband and telecommunications consulting and engineering services to state broadband offices, public agencies, municipalities, and other government entities nationwide. Broadband Practice supports clients through technical advisory services, broadband planning, data analysis and mapping, verification and challenge support, and grant and program implementation support. Michael Baker’s work includes advising clients on broadband technologies, evaluating broadband availability and serviceability information, and interpreting data and documentation received from Internet service providers in support of public-sector decision-making. The Broadband Practice also supports broadband technology evaluation, cost and schedule analysis, grant management, program and project strategy, risk assessments, and technical review of deployment-related information across wired and wireless environments.

What We're Looking For

The Broadband Engineering Consultant will support multiple broadband consulting engagements for public-sector clients, primarily state and local governments. This role combines technical expertise in broadband networks with strong analytical, communication, and project coordination skills. Responsibilities include reviewing, validating, and evaluating broadband network designs and related supporting data and documentation, as well as supporting field validation activities to assess technical accuracy, compliance, and alignment with program requirements.

The ideal candidate brings professional telecommunications and hands-on experience deploying fiber (FTTH, GPON/XGS-PON) and/or fixed wireless networks; a working knowledge of PON architectures and DOCSIS environments; strong understanding of wireless networks and technologies; and familiarity with real-world network deployment and operations. The candidate should be comfortable interpreting technical documentation and broadband-related data, evaluating network assumptions, and translating complex telecommunications concepts into clear, client-ready analyses and deliverables. Experience supporting desktop and field deployment validation activities and helping public-sector clients navigate broadband funding and compliance requirements is strongly preferred.

What You'll Do

  • Support consulting engagements for state broadband offices, municipalities, and other public-sector clients related to broadband programs, telecommunications strategy, technical review, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Review and assess broadband network-related data and supporting documentation, including service data, deployment project-area information, location information, technology descriptions, and deployment-related records.
  • Analyze broadband serviceable locations (BSLs), project areas, and related datasets using spreadsheets, tabular analysis, GIS tools, targeted software platforms, and supporting technical documentation to identify inconsistencies, trends, gaps, and deployment project risks.
  • Evaluate broadband technologies and network environments including fiber, PON-based systems, DOCSIS concepts, and fixed and mobile wireless, to support technical advisory.
  • Support technical review of broadband grant applications and related program materials, including scoring inputs, risk indicators, and location-level documentation used during application and award phases.
  • Support verification and challenge process activities by reviewing ISP-submitted evidence, assessing data and documentation quality, and helping document findings for public-sector decision-making.
  • Prepare technical memoranda, issue logs, comparison analyses, summary reports, presentations, and other client-facing deliverables that clearly communicate findings to public-sector stakeholders.
  • Assist clients and project teams in understanding broadband deployment assumptions, cost and schedule considerations, serviceability issues, and technology distinctions, and the implications of these data on program decisions.
  • Coordinate and support field teams conducting broadband validation activities, including guidance on field procedures, documentation expectations, data collection requirements, location validation, and consistency in reporting.
  • Provide day-to-day technical support and coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including project managers, analysts, GIS staff, and field personnel helping to resolve issues and create timely, accurate, and defensible client deliverables.
  • Participate in internal and client meetings; present technical information in clear written and oral formats for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Occasional travel may be required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 4–8 years of experience involving broadband, telecommunications, network systems, GIS and mapping workflows, infrastructure analysis, technical consulting, or public-sector broadband program support.
  • Expert understanding of broadband technologies, including fiber and fixed wireless systems, and the ability to apply that knowledge in an advisory and analytical setting.
  • Familiarity with working network environments, including PON (GPON / XGS-PON) and/or DOCSIS concepts as well as a working knowledge of wireless network infrastructure, technologies, and spectrum use.
  • Ability to interpret technical documentation, network-related materials, broadband availability and serviceability information, and ISP-submitted program data (including evidence used for verification and challenge processes).
  • Experience working with spreadsheets and structured datasets, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines.

Preferred/Highly Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting state broadband offices, public-sector telecommunications programs, or federally/state-funded broadband initiatives.
  • Familiarity or experience with the Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment (BEAD) and Capital Projects Fund (CPF) broadband programs, grant administration support, field validation, and other compliance-oriented activities.
  • Experience reviewing broadband funding applications and the associated project-area information, risk indicators, scoring inputs, or technical support materials.
  • Working knowledge of satellite communications, especially as related to the BEAD program.
  • Experience using GIS tools such as ArcGIS or QGIS in support of location, project-area, or serviceability analysis.
  • Experience developing procedures, guidance documents, or training materials for technical or field-based teams.
  • Ability to translate technical broadband concepts into clear advisory guidance for clients, project teams, and public-sector stakeholders.

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with a minimum of 4-6 years of broadband network design/engineering primarily as a consultant
  • Certifications in network engineering design or related fields preferred but not required

Compensation

The approximate compensation range for this position is $69,731 to $100,692. This compensation range is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation is dependent upon factors such as education, qualifications, experience, skillset, and physical work location.

Why Choose Us

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 401 (k) Retirement Plan
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Life, AD&D, short-term, and long-term disability
  • Professional and personal development
  • Generous paid time off
  • Commuter and wellness benefits

ABOUT YOUR NEW ROLE

Do you enjoy writing and want to build a career in sports digital media? The Sporting News is seeking an ambitious, motivated and creative recent college graduate for a paid six-month content producer internship from August 2026 through February 2027.

This is a hands-on editorial role supporting The Sporting News and its growing network of media and commercial partnerships. You will write content for Sporting News platforms as well as regional sports network partners, including NESN and SportsNet Pittsburgh (SNP), producing coverage tailored to national, Boston and Pittsburgh audiences.

You will create content across a wide range of topics and formats, from breaking news and live-event coverage to evergreen, lifestyle and affiliate content. No two days will look the same. One assignment may involve reacting quickly to a major sports story, while the next could focus on building a search-friendly guide, supporting a partner’s coverage strategy or contributing to a live blog around a marquee event.

You will work closely with Sporting News editors to learn how content is planned, written, packaged and distributed for different audiences and platforms. You will also gain experience collaborating across departments and understanding how editorial content supports audience growth, partnerships and commercial objectives.

Throughout the internship, you will learn how Sporting News works with partners, applies SEO and audience best practices, covers major sporting events and creates content that delivers value for readers, media partners and commercial brands.

WHEN AND WHERE IS IT?

Dates: August 2026 - February 2027

Pay: $15 per hour, up to 40 hours per week

Location: Remote or Charlotte, N.C.

Apply by August 14, 2026

INTERNSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Write a high volume of clean, accurate and engaging digital content across sports, lifestyle, affiliate and partnership verticals
  • Cover breaking news and produce timely content around major stories, games and sporting events
  • Produce and manage live coverage, including live blogs, game updates and event-based content
  • Write and update evergreen articles designed to serve readers throughout the sports calendar
  • Create content for The Sporting News and its partners, including regional sports networks NESN and SportsNet Pittsburgh and other sports media brands
  • Work with editors to tailor content, tone and formatting for different audiences and publishing platforms
  • Apply SEO best practices to headlines, article structure, keyword targeting and content packaging
  • Use audience and research tools such as Google Trends and Semrush to identify story opportunities
  • Monitor sports news, schedules, trends and social conversations to generate relevant content ideas
  • Update existing articles to ensure information remains accurate, useful and timely
  • Collaborate with editors, writers and other departments to support partnership and audience-growth initiatives
  • Learn how editorial content contributes to the broader commercial value of a global sports media organization

REQUIREMENTS

  • You must be able to commit to the entire six-month program. For this reason, we consider only recent graduates who are less than 12 months removed from completing their degree
  • An ability to work quickly, accurately and efficiently in a digital news environment
  • Strong news judgment and an understanding of what makes a sports story timely, relevant and interesting
  • The ability to write clean, concise and engaging content in a variety of digital formats
  • Strong knowledge of major North American professional and collegiate sports
  • An interest in covering a variety of subjects, including sports, lifestyle, live events and affiliate content
  • A basic understanding of SEO best practices and digital audience development
  • An entrepreneurial and curious mindset with an eagerness to pitch ideas, test new approaches and learn
  • The versatility to move between breaking news, evergreen assignments and partner-specific projects
  • Strong grammar skills, meticulous attention to detail and a firm grasp of AP style
  • A willingness to work collaboratively with editors and writers and respond positively to constructive feedback
  • The ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines at the same time
  • Flexibility to work a combination of days, nights and weekends as required by the sports calendar

ABOUT SPORTING NEWS, THE COMPANY

Sporting News is more than a media brand—we are a global team of passionate sports fans delivering trusted content to audiences around the world. Founded in 1886, we have a 140-year legacy of sports journalism excellence, evolving from a print publication into a cutting-edge digital media company that serves millions of fans across multiple platforms and languages.

At our core, we believe in expert storytelling, ensuring that every piece of content we produce meets the high expectations of modern sports enthusiasts.

Our Employee Value Proposition is built on five key pillars:

  • Expect Curiosity – We embrace change, constantly exploring new ways to engage fans and stay ahead in the evolving sports media landscape.
  • Operate with Integrity – Trust is the foundation of Sporting News, and we uphold that tradition by delivering fact-based, insightful coverage.
  • Answer with Expertise – With a deep understanding of sports and its impact, our team delivers content that is knowledgeable, analytical, and forward-thinking.
  • Deliver Consistently – Whether breaking news, in-depth analysis, or immersive storytelling, we strive to provide high-quality content that resonates with fans.
  • Trust One Another – Our global team collaborates across borders, fostering a culture of respect and inclusion.

At Sporting News, we celebrate the diversity of our team and leadership. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone—regardless of race, gender, background, or identity—can contribute, grow, and succeed.

ABOUT SPORTING NEWS, THE BRAND

Sporting News is one of the most storied and recognizable sports media brands in the world. Founded in 1886 as a U.S. weekly newspaper, it became a pioneering force in sports journalism—earning titles like "The Nation's Oldest & Finest Sports Paper" and "The Bible of Baseball."

Today, Sporting News is a digital-first, globally connected media powerhouse with localized editions in the U.S., Brazil, Canada, Mexico, Argentina, U.K., Spain, India, Thailand, Vietnam, Australia, and Japan— with more regions on the horizon.

  1. Timeless & Crafted. No other publisher carries the heritage of Sporting News. Our legacy of expert sports journalism has stood the test of time, from baseball’s golden age to today’s global sports landscape.
  2. Imaginative & Scalable. Sporting News now covers all major sports worldwide, leveraging a network of local experts who understand regional nuances while delivering global impact.
  3. Reliable & Relatable. With a rich history and deep audience trust, Sporting News is the go-to platform for rights holders, gaming partners, advertisers, broadcasters— and most importantly, sports fans.

As we approach our 140-year milestone, Sporting News remains committed to evolving with the ever-changing sports media landscape while staying true to the values that have defined us for generations.

Acquired by an international investment group in 2021 with deep sports, media and gaming experience, TSN is poised to become the first truly global digital sports media platform business.
